funding.value: All admitted students receive $2,386/month stipend and Graduate Tuition Fellowship covering tuition and fees.
funding.quote: You will receive a monthly stipend of $2,386/month (U. S. $28,632 per year) through either a Teaching Assistantship (TA) or Research Assistantship (RA). In addition, tuition and mandatory fees will be covered by the Graduate Tuition Fellowship (GTF).
